讚美之泉
詞：鄭懋柔 Tiffany M. Cheng／曲：游智婷 Sandy Yu

lines.a: 芥菜種的信心 可以將大山挪開
lines.b: Mountains and hills can move at the smallest seed of faith

lines.a: 相信神的應許 可以跨越困難
lines.b: Through the trials and hardships, I can trust in His way

lines.a: 信心的禱告 神都聽見
lines.b: God hears my every word, when I pray in faith

lines.a: 大聲地宣告 勇敢向前
lines.b: I will shout it out, I'm not afraid

lines.a: 在祢沒有 沒有難成的事
lines.b: In You, there is nothing impossible

lines.a: 軟弱和憂慮中 祢不曾放棄我
lines.b: Even when I am weak, You never let me go

lines.a: 祢的應許 應許 不論有多少
lines.b: All Your promises, promises, I can't count them all
Every promise is yes and amen

lines.a: 祢的應許 應許 不論有多少
lines.b: All Your promises, promises, I can't count them all
Every promise is yes and amen
